title: Marijn's Food Effects
description: Makes (almost) all food items give special effects when eaten. Features a bunch of optimization options through /function food_effects:config
body:
Makes (almost) all food items give special effects when eaten. Features a bunch of optimization options through /function food_effects:config

before removing the datapack, make sure to run /function food_effects:uninstall to clear stored data. This function is also available through the config menu.
